guides.favoredWhen: She bullies the lane but your R is the matchup. Concede damage, reveal shroud, roam.

keyTips.text: Her damage beats your cards: concede the 1v1.
Your R reveals her shroud: the matchup turns on Destiny.
Hold your R: the held reveal blanks her stealth.

tips.text: She dodges Q and gold, E-ing as your W comes: vary the timing.
Your stacked-deck auto is your trade: hold the glow until she commits.
She calls your 6: roam before the team reacts.
She bullies but cannot match your map: shove and vanish.
Cards picked plus reveals timed: the Akali who never touches you never wins.

guides.favoredWhen: She punishes every card window and holds Charm for Gold. Shove and roam before she does.

keyTips.text: She trades after your Pick a Card (about {cd:4:W}): the cooldown is her window.
She times Charm onto your Gold walk-up: expect it at the same moment.
She Qs you walking to last-hit: concede some CS to dodge.

tips.text: Your waveclear and trading are weak: concede early, survive the pressure.
She ults in for big chunks after 6: hold Gold Card for her dives.
She keeps pressure so you cannot roam: shove before she does.
You bait Charm with fake steps and unlocked cards: keep faking, never walk real Golds predictably.
Shove and move first: the axis is roam pressure, and your ult beats her shove.

guides.favoredWhen: She wins the lane hard and keeps you pushed in. Survive, track jungle, roam on first window.

keyTips.text: She wins the lane hard: play to survive, not to press.
She keeps you pushed in: a TF under tower cannot roam, so break out.
Pushed waves invite ganks: your jungler is your lane partner.

tips.text: She does not force: take the free farm and scale.
Her Q spam has a plan: sidestep the pattern, punish the dry spells.
She plays for pushing and map pressure: match Teleport with your ult.
Every wave she crashes denies a roam: thin the wave before it lands.
Never held plus jungler dodged: the Syndra who never keeps you in never beats you.

guides.favoredWhen: He shoves to punish every roam and holds R for Gold. Roam on crashed waves, never into a held R.

keyTips.text: The lane is fine for him but you roam: his job is making every roam cost you.
He always shoves: the minions you miss and plates he takes are the matchup.
He Rs after your Gold Card: throw it only with backup.

early-lane.text: Zed often places Living Shadow before Death Mark so he can swap away from skillshots. Hold your crowd control until he has used the swap.

win-condition.text: Death Mark always lands Zed behind his target. Pre-aim crowd control and escapes behind you, not toward where he cast it.

tips.text: Your stacked-deck auto is your trade: force when the glow is up.
He pokes to keep you in lane: chunked HP cannot roam, so stay healthy.
Death Mark always lands Zed behind his target. Pre-aim crowd control and escapes behind you, not toward where he cast it.
He tracks your R and pings every vanish: roam only on crashed waves.
Win the map, not the duel: a Zed whose shove never holds you is a Zed who loses.

keyTips.text: Play for reliable farming and a controlled wave before level six; burst and melee lanes punish Twisted Fate early, so respect their windows.
At level six, push and use Destiny to threaten side lanes, counter a dive, or reveal enemy positions; after Lich Bane, shove the side wave and hover near mid or the bot-side jungle for picks.
In fights, poke with Q and wait for a safe Gold Card window instead of frontlining; use Destiny to find an isolated target, arrive with Gold Card ready, then follow with an auto and Wild Cards.

tips.text: Use Wild Cards for low-risk poke and ranged wave trimming, and Pick a Card to last-hit safely, including under tower.
Take W at level one, Q at two, E at three, then max Q, W, E while taking R at six, eleven, and sixteen; take the early E point into aggressive melee lanes for stronger trades.
Trade Gold Card into Wild Cards plus an auto to add Stacked Deck damage; clear with Red Card plus Q and restore mana with Blue Card plus Q.
Freeze near your tower when behind or threatened by an assassin, slow-push before a planned Destiny roam, and fast-push before a recall or map move.
Ward river entrances defensively early, and with mid priority ward enemy Raptors or a Red Buff entrance to track the jungler and open safer roams.
After one or two core items, shove the assigned side wave and hover near mid or the bot-side jungle for picks rather than sitting in lane.
Keep side-lane pressure within vision; otherwise group or collect waves as they reach your tower.
Before Dragon, Rift Herald, or Baron, control nearby vision and push a side wave so the enemy must answer it.
Use Destiny to reveal the enemy jungler's location during a clear, choosing between a roam, a reset, or an objective from that information.
Protect carries with Gold Card when an enemy diver reaches them; focus on pick setup and map pressure rather than frontline damage.
Late game, stay with the team unless Destiny is available and side-lane vision makes a split safe; never face-check fog.
Extend Gold Card threat with Rapid Firecannon for picks and sieges, using a catch to start Baron, Elder Dragon, or a tower push.
Activate Destiny before or during an objective fight when the reveal exposes enemy positions or a flank.

itemization.text: Choose Electrocute for burst in short-range lanes, First Strike as the safer scaling and gold-acceleration page, or Unsealed Spellbook for utility and flexible summoner spells; the First Strike page pairs Cash Back, Triple Tonic, and Jack of All Trades with Celerity and Gathering Storm.
Run Flash by default with Teleport as the consistent ranked pairing, Ignite for aggressive kill pressure, Exhaust against burst, or Ghost for extended skirmishes with limited enemy crowd control.

Follow the Luden's path from Doran's Ring and potions into Luden's Echo, Sorcerer's Shoes, Lich Bane, Rabadon's Deathcap, and Void Staff, ending with Mejai's or Rapid Firecannon; take Rod of Ages into the safer first-item route with Lich Bane and defenses, or the burn path into three or more tanks.
